acceptance_criteria: Add an audit configuration path for the ASGI app using a local filesystem path controlled by environment/config, not secrets.
When audit persistence is configured, GET /inspection/replay initializes the audit store and idempotently records the current replay inspection snapshot.
When audit persistence is configured, POST /feedback stores valid feedback for the current replay inspection in qc_feedback and returns audit persistence evidence in the HTTP response.
Repeated HMI refresh and feedback submissions do not fail because the replay inspection already exists.
Invalid feedback payloads are rejected without creating audit feedback rows.
HMI displays audit persistence status when present in /feedback response.
Existing no-audit behavior remains valid when no audit path is configured.
Required local checks pass and no restricted behavior is introduced.

memory_preflight.query: Flange QC v2 HMI feedback durable audit persistence, issue #97, FQV2-019 residual risk, no-camera replay audit store
retrieved_decisions: GitHub/docs/tests/PR evidence remain source of truth.
Feedback is shadow-only and cannot approve production authority.
Current HMI feedback returns validation evidence; durable HMI feedback persistence was a recorded residual risk.
Audit store already supports append-only inspections and qc_feedback tables.
retrieved_lessons: Keep no-camera progress useful while hardware is unavailable.
Expose authority and audit blockers clearly.
Do not introduce production release or hardware behavior through persistence work.

rollback_note: Revert the FQV2-020 PR to remove audit persistence wiring, HMI audit status display, tests, docs, and gate evidence.
